bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
echo BOT_RUNNING=PASS
echo PROJECT_HEAD="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
for tag in gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-pr62-20261120; do
  if docker image inspect "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "IMAGE_PRESENT=$tag"; else echo "IMAGE_ABSENT=$tag"; fi
done
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"; then echo RUNNING_MATCHES_LOCAL=YES; else echo RUNNING_MATCHES_LOCAL=NO; fi
if test -d "$root/.worktrees/link-pr62-15e86a1"; then echo PR62_STAGE_PRESENT=YES; else echo PR62_STAGE_PRESENT=NO; fi
if test -d "$root/node_modules"; then echo ROOT_MODULES=YES; else echo ROOT_MODULES=NO; fi
if test -d "$root/artifacts/bot/node_modules"; then echo BOT_MODULES=YES; else echo BOT_MODULES=NO; fi
echo USERBOT_SERVICE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
